When the car arrived, buggy whip makers had to choose how to react.

Kevin Trudeau points out that everything has always changed. People lit their homes with whale oil, then kerosene, then electricity.

He pictures buggy whip makers asking whether the new horseless carriage would affect them. Some said no and went bankrupt. Others said they weren't sure, but started making things for that future. Kevin's lesson: keep your ability to create, whatever the situation.

What change are you getting ready for?
